<style>
/* ── global link defaults (palette-based; prevents browser-blue on new links) ── */
a{color:var(--pri);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s var(--silk);}
a:hover{color:var(--pri-d);}
[data-theme="dark"] a{color:#e9c176;}
[data-theme="dark"] a:hover{color:#c8961a;}
/* ── hero slider ── */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:640px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:70px 0 140px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a1622;}
.hero .slide{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.5s var(--silk);z-index:0;transform:scale(1.08);}
.hero .slide.on{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}
.hero .slide img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
/* Ken Burns zoom removed — was causing unwanted movement on hero */
.hero .scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.2) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 30%,rgba(0,0,0,.15) 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%);}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero .scrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,8,10,.55) 0%,rgba(8,8,10,.38) 40%,rgba(8,8,10,.82) 100%);}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero .h-eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.32em;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#8fe1ff;margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:18px;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
[dir="rtl"] .hero .h-eyebrow{letter-spacing:.06em;font-family:var(--font);}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero .h-eyebrow{color:#e9c176;}
.hero .h-eyebrow::before{content:"";width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--pri);display:inline-block;}
.hero h1{color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-size:54px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.015em;max-width:760px;line-height:1.08;min-height:1.2em;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
[dir="rtl"] .hero h1{letter-spacing:0;font-family:'Cairo','Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:800;}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--pri);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero h1 .hl{color:#e9c176;}
.hero h1 .hl::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;margin-inline-start:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pri);vertical-align:middle;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--pri);transform:translateY(-2px);}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero h1 .hl::after{background:#e9c176;box-shadow:0 0 14px #e9c176;}
.hero p.sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-size:15.5px;margin-top:18px;max-width:520px;line-height:1.55;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font-weight:500;}
.hero .quick{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:18px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hero .quick span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.hero .quick .i{color:var(--pri);}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero .quick .i{color:#e9c176;}
.hero .dots{position:absolute;bottom:104px;inset-inline-start:24px;z-index:3;display:flex;gap:8px;}
.hero .dots button{width:26px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;padding:0;}
.hero .dots button.on{background:var(--pri);width:44px;}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero .dots button.on{background:#e9c176;}
.hero .map-cta{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:100px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:4;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 18px;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s var(--silk);white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;}
.hero .map-cta:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.24);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);}
.hero .map-cta .mc-ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pri);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;animation:pulseDot 2.4s infinite;}
[data-theme="dark"] .hero .map-cta .mc-ic{background:#c8961a;color:#0d0d0f;}
.hero .map-cta .i{width:14px;height:14px;}
@media(max-width:680px){.hero .map-cta{bottom:96px;font-size:13px;padding:11px 18px;}}
@media(max-width:980px){.hero h1{font-size:42px;}.hero p.sub{font-size:14.5px;}}
@media(max-width:680px){.hero h1{font-size:32px;line-height:1.12;max-width:100%;}.hero p.sub{font-size:13.5px;}.hero .h-eyebrow{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;}.hero{min-height:560px;padding:60px 0 120px;}}
@media(max-width:420px){.hero h1{font-size:26px;}}

/* ── LASER BEAM — appears fast, descends slowly (like video: ~3s sweep) ──
     Inside hero only. z-index 6 (above scrim, below search card). */
.page-laser{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:100%;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;border-radius:inherit;}
.page-laser-beam{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 5%,rgba(233,193,118,.4) 15%,#e9c176 35%,#fff 50%,#e9c176 65%,rgba(233,193,118,.4) 85%,transparent 95%);border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(233,193,118,1),0 0 40px rgba(200,150,26,.7),0 0 60px rgba(200,150,26,.3),0 0 80px rgba(200,150,26,.15);animation:laserSweepDown 5s ease-in-out infinite;}
/* Laser: pause at top (0-15%), descend (15-75%), pause at bottom (75-100%)
   This creates a visible "rest" at the top before the beam sweeps down. */
@keyframes laserSweepDown{
  0%{top:0;opacity:0;}
  5%{opacity:1;}
  15%{top:0;opacity:1;}
  75%{top:100%;opacity:1;}
  85%{top:100%;opacity:0;}
  100%{top:0;opacity:0;}
}
@media(max-width:768px){.page-laser-beam{height:2px;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(233,193,118,.9),0 0 28px rgba(200,150,26,.5),0 0 42px rgba(200,150,26,.2);}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.page-laser-beam{animation:none;opacity:.4;top:50%;}}

/* ── TWEAKS PANEL — accent color + corner style customization ── */
.tweaks-trigger{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;z-index:9998;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s var(--silk);}
.tweaks-trigger:hover{transform:scale(1.08);border-color:var(--accent,#00aeff);}
.tweaks-trigger .i{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--accent,#00aeff);}
.tweaks-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.tweaks-overlay.on{display:flex;}
.tweaks-panel{background:var(--surface);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;width:340px;max-width:90vw;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);animation:tweaksIn .3s var(--silk) both;}
@keyframes tweaksIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92) translateY(10px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.tweaks-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px;}
.tweaks-head h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:0;}
.tweaks-close{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--bg);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.2s;}
.tweaks-close:hover{background:var(--line);color:var(--ink);}
.tweaks-section{margin-bottom:24px;}
.tweaks-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px;}
.tweaks-swatches{display:flex;gap:12px;}
.tweaks-swatch{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;border:3px solid transparent;transition:.2s var(--silk);position:relative;}
.tweaks-swatch.on{border-color:var(--ink);transform:scale(1.08);}
.tweaks-swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
.tweaks-corners{display:flex;gap:8px;}
.tweaks-corner-btn{flex:1;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;}
.tweaks-corner-btn.on{background:var(--accent,#00aeff);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent,#00aeff);}
[data-theme="dark"] .tweaks-corner-btn.on{color:#09090f;}
.tweaks-font-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tweaks-font-btn{flex:1;min-width:60px;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;text-align:center;}
.tweaks-font-btn.on{background:var(--accent,#00aeff);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent,#00aeff);}
[data-theme="dark"] .tweaks-font-btn.on{color:#09090f;}
@media(max-width:680px){.tweaks-panel{padding:20px;width:300px;}.tweaks-swatch{width:38px;height:38px;}}
.tweaks-logo-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
.tweaks-logo-preview{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface-2);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;flex:none;}
.tweaks-logo-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
.tweaks-logo-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;flex:1;}
.tweaks-logo-upload{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent,#00aeff);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s var(--silk);}
.tweaks-logo-upload:hover{filter:brightness(1.06);}
[data-theme="dark"] .tweaks-logo-upload{color:#09090f;}
.tweaks-logo-reset{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s var(--silk);}
.tweaks-logo-reset:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#00aeff);}

/* ── CALM BELL BAR — Request Now + 25% OFF ── */
.bell-bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy),#0a1622);padding:10px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.bell-content{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;}
.bell-text{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;direction:rtl;text-align:center;}
.bell-text b{color:#34d399;font-weight:800;}
.bell-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;background:#e63946;color:#fff;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;animation:bellFlash 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes bellFlash{0%,100%{background:#e63946;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(230,57,70,.3);}50%{background:#f59e0b;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(245,158,11,.5);}}
.bell-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e9c176,#c8961a);color:#09090f;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;transition:.25s var(--silk);direction:rtl;}
.bell-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(200,150,26,.4);}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bell-badge{animation:none;}}
@media(max-width:680px){.bell-text{font-size:11px;}.bell-bar{padding:8px 12px;}}

/* ── Sticky map — freezes below header when scrolled to ── */
.map-sticky-wrap{position:relative;transition:all .3s var(--silk);}
.map-sticky-wrap.sticky{position:sticky;top:64px;z-index:50;}
.map-sticky-wrap.sticky #home-map{height:280px;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;border-top:none;}
@media(max-width:768px){.map-sticky-wrap.sticky{top:56px;}.map-sticky-wrap.sticky #home-map{height:200px;}}

/* ── search card ── */
.searchbar{position:relative;z-index:5;margin-top:-76px;}
.search-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;}
.search-tabs{display:flex;padding:0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.search-tabs button{background:none;border:none;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--text);padding:16px 22px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;}
.search-tabs button.active{color:var(--pri);}
.search-tabs button.active::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:-1px;height:3px;background:var(--pri);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;}
.search-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr auto;}
.field{padding:16px 20px;border-inline-end:1px solid var(--line);}
.field:last-child{border-inline-end:none;}
.field label{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px;}
[dir="rtl"] .field label{letter-spacing:.02em;font-family:var(--font);}
.field .val{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;}
.field .val .i{color:var(--pri);width:17px;height:17px;}
.field .val .chev{margin-inline-start:auto;color:var(--muted);width:16px;height:16px;}
.field.searchbtn{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;}
.field.searchbtn .btn{width:100%;height:100%;padding:14px 26px;font-size:15px;}

/* ── compounds preview ── */
.grid-comp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;}
.comp{position:relative;height:250px;border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:block;}
.comp img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--silk);}
.comp:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);}
.comp .co-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,25,45,0) 30%,rgba(0,25,45,.82) 100%);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;}
.comp .co-body{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:18px;inset-inline-end:18px;bottom:16px;z-index:3;color:#fff;pointer-events:none;}
.comp .co-body h4{color:#fff;font-size:18px;}
.comp .co-body span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:#bfeaff;letter-spacing:.05em;}
[data-theme="dark"] .comp .co-body span{color:#e9c176;}
.comp .co-count{position:absolute;top:14px;inset-inline-end:14px;z-index:3;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap;}

/* ── 360 rooms strip ── */
.rooms{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:minmax(340px,1fr);gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:12px;scrollbar-width:thin;}
.room{position:relative;height:300px;border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;scroll-snap-align:start;}
.room img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--silk);}
.room:hover img{transform:scale(1.07);}
.room .r-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,rgba(0,20,38,.85) 100%);z-index:2;}
.room .r-body{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:20px;inset-inline-end:20px;bottom:18px;z-index:3;}
.room .r-body h4{color:#fff;font-size:19px;}
.room .r-body span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);letter-spacing:.05em;}
.room .r-360{position:absolute;top:16px;inset-inline-start:16px;z-index:3;background:rgba(0,174,255,.92);color:#fff;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;animation:floaty 4s ease-in-out infinite;}
[data-theme="dark"] .room .r-360{background:rgba(200,150,26,.94);color:#0d0d0f;}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.room .r-360{animation:none;}}

/* ── stats ── */
.stats{background:var(--navy);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.stats::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 85% 10%,rgba(0,174,255,.22),transparent 60%);}
[data-theme="dark"] .stats::before{background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 85% 10%,rgba(200,150,26,.16),transparent 60%);}
.stats .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;padding:56px 24px;}
.stat{text-align:center;color:#fff;}
.stat b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:42px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pri);display:block;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
[data-theme="dark"] .stat b{color:#e9c176;}
.stat span{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-weight:500;}

/* ── why ── */
.net-banner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;background:var(--navy);border-radius:16px;padding:44px 48px;margin-bottom:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
[data-theme="dark"] .net-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12100a,#221c0d);border:1px solid rgba(200,150,26,.25);}
.net-banner::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(560px 300px at 100% 0%,rgba(0,174,255,.18),transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;}
[data-theme="dark"] .net-banner::before{background:radial-gradient(560px 300px at 100% 0%,rgba(200,150,26,.16),transparent 62%);}
.net-banner>*{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.net-banner .eyebrow{color:#8fe1ff;margin-bottom:14px;}
[data-theme="dark"] .net-banner .eyebrow{color:#e9c176;}
.net-banner .eyebrow::before{background:currentColor;}
.net-banner h3{color:#fff;font-size:26px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.net-banner p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);margin-top:14px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;}
.nb-stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;border-inline-start:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-inline-start:36px;}
.nb-stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:38px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pri);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;}
[data-theme="dark"] .nb-stat b{color:#e9c176;}
.nb-stat span{display:block;color:rgba(255,255,255,.66);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px;}
.grid-feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;}
.feat{padding:28px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);transition:.25s var(--silk);background:var(--surface);}
.feat:hover{border-color:var(--pri);box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.feat .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--pri-soft);color:var(--pri);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;}
.feat .ic .i{width:24px;height:24px;}
.feat h4{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.feat p{font-size:13.5px;}

/* ── cta ── */
.cta{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;padding:56px 60px;background:var(--pri);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
[data-theme="dark"] .cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c8961a,#8f6a0f);}
.cta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(500px 260px at 90% -20%,rgba(255,255,255,.25),transparent 60%);}
.cta .ct-txt{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cta h2{color:#fff;font-size:30px;}
.cta p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);margin-top:8px;font-size:16px;}
.cta .ct-act{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.cta .btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--pri);}
[data-theme="dark"] .cta .btn-white{color:#8f6a0f;}
.cta .btn-white:hover{background:#f0fbff;}
.cta .btn-out{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);color:#fff;}
.cta .btn-out:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}

/* ── testimonials ── */
.testi-band{background:var(--pri-soft);}
[data-theme="dark"] .testi-band{background:#15130c;}
.grid-testi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px;}
.grid-testi .tcard:first-child{grid-row:1 / 3;}
.grid-testi .tcard:first-child p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;}
.tcard{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;transition:.25s var(--silk);}
.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);}
.tcard .stars{display:flex;gap:3px;color:#f5a623;}
.tcard .stars .i{width:15px;height:15px;fill:currentColor;}
.tcard p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;flex:1;}
.tcard .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px;}
.tcard .who .av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--pri);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;flex:none;}
[data-theme="dark"] .tcard .who .av{background:#221c0d;color:#e9c176;}
.tcard .who b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:13.5px;}
.tcard .who small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}

/* ── perfect choice + inquiry ── */
.perfect{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);}
.perfect .pf-left{position:relative;background:var(--navy);padding:52px 48px;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;}
.perfect .pf-left::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600047509807-ba8f99d2cdde?w=1200&q=70') center/cover;opacity:.14;}
.perfect .pf-left::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 10% 0%,rgba(0,174,255,.25),transparent 60%);}
[data-theme="dark"] .perfect .pf-left::after{background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 10% 0%,rgba(200,150,26,.2),transparent 60%);}
.perfect .pf-left>*{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.perfect .pf-left h2{color:#fff;font-size:30px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.perfect .pf-left>p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-bottom:30px;}
.pf-item{display:flex;gap:18px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);}
.pf-item .num{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:26px;color:var(--pri);flex:none;line-height:1.2;}
[data-theme="dark"] .pf-item .num{color:#e9c176;}
.pf-item h4{color:#fff;font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:5px;}
.pf-item p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;}
.inq{background:var(--surface);padding:44px 42px;}
.inq h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.inq>p{font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:22px;}
.inq .seg{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.inq .seg button{flex:1;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;}
.inq .seg button.on{background:var(--pri);border-color:var(--pri);color:#fff;}
[data-theme="dark"] .inq .seg button.on{color:#0d0d0f;}
.inq .frow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.inq label{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px;}
[dir="rtl"] .inq label{letter-spacing:.02em;font-family:var(--font);}
.inq input,.inq select{width:100%;font-family:var(--font);font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s;}
.inq input:focus,.inq select:focus{border-color:var(--pri);}
.inq .btn{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:13px;}

/* ── partners ── */
.partners{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:44px 0;background:var(--surface-2);}
.partners .p-eye{text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:26px;}
[dir="rtl"] .partners .p-eye{letter-spacing:.05em;font-family:var(--font);}
.partners .row{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:52px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.partners .row span{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--muted);opacity:.75;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap;}
.partners .row span:hover{color:var(--pri);opacity:1;}

/* ── market ticker ── */
.ticker{background:var(--navy);border-top:1px solid rgba(200,150,26,.2);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,150,26,.2);overflow:hidden;padding:11px 0;}
[data-theme="dark"] .ticker{background:#0a0a0c;}
.ticker .row{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:tickerMove 30s linear infinite;}
[dir="rtl"] .ticker .row{animation-direction:reverse;}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ticker .row{animation:none;}}
@keyframes tickerMove{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ticker .row span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 20px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e9c176;white-space:nowrap;}
[dir="rtl"] .ticker .row span{letter-spacing:.02em;font-family:var(--font);}
.ticker .row span::after{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#c8961a;opacity:.7;}

/* ── AI hub (light band, matches page) ── */
.ai-hub{background:var(--bg);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:74px 0;}
.ai-hub::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-160px;left:50%;width:520px;height:520px;margin-left:-260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,174,255,.10),rgba(200,150,26,.06),transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;}
/* Branded background: large Sierra logo watermark (mouse-parallax, floating) */
.ai-hub::after{content:none;}
.ai-watermark{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:min(660px,82vw);height:min(660px,82vw);margin:calc(min(660px,82vw)/-2) 0 0 calc(min(660px,82vw)/-2);background:url('logo-gold.png') center/contain no-repeat;opacity:.14;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;mix-blend-mode:multiply;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#000 42%,transparent 70%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#000 42%,transparent 70%);animation:aiFloat 14s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);will-change:transform;}
[data-theme="dark"] .ai-watermark{mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:.12;}
@keyframes aiFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-1.5deg)}50%{transform:translate3d(0,-18px,0) rotate(1.5deg)}}
.ai-gridlines{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,174,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,174,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:48px 48px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 72%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 72%);}
.ai-hub .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.ai-hub .ai-eye{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00aeff;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
[dir="rtl"] .ai-hub .ai-eye{letter-spacing:.04em;font-family:var(--font);}
.ai-hub .ai-eye .live{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;animation:blink 2s infinite;box-shadow:0 0 8px #4ade80;}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.2}}
.ai-hub h2{color:var(--ink);font-size:34px;max-width:640px;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.ai-hub .ai-lead{color:var(--text);font-size:15px;margin-top:10px;max-width:520px;}
.ai-hub .ai-scan{margin:26px 0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#00aeff,#c8961a,transparent);position:relative;}
.ai-hub .ai-scan::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-3px;left:0;right:0;height:7px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(0,174,255,.2),rgba(200,150,26,.2),transparent);animation:scanLine 3s linear infinite;}
@keyframes scanLine{0%{transform:translateX(-30%)}100%{transform:translateX(30%)}}
.ai-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;}
.ai-card{padding:22px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-s);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .3s var(--silk),border-color .3s var(--silk),box-shadow .3s var(--silk);text-align:start;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:block;text-decoration:none;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
.ai-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:radial-gradient(280px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(0,174,255,.16),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s var(--silk);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
.ai-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.ai-card>*{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.ai-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00aeff,#c8961a);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s var(--silk);}
.ai-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(0,174,255,.5);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,174,255,.14);}
.ai-card:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);}
.ai-card .ai-ic{width:46px;height:46px;margin-bottom:13px;display:inline-flex;}
.ai-card .ai-ic svg{width:46px;height:46px;}
.ai-card h4{color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:5px;}
.ai-card p{color:var(--text);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;}
.ai-card .live-tag{margin-top:11px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4ade80;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-family:var(--mono);}
.ai-card .live-tag::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;animation:blink 2s infinite;box-shadow:0 0 6px #4ade80;}

/* ── tour launch ── */
.tour-launch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;width:100%;padding:20px 24px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#0a3a63);border:1px solid rgba(200,150,26,.35);cursor:pointer;text-align:start;transition:.25s var(--silk);}
[data-theme="dark"] .tour-launch{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12100a,#26200f);}
.tour-launch:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-m);}
.tour-launch .t-ic{flex:none;color:#e9c176;}
.tour-launch .t-txt{flex:1;}
.tour-launch .t-txt b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:3px;}
.tour-launch .t-txt span{color:#e9c176;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--mono);}
[dir="rtl"] .tour-launch .t-txt span{font-family:var(--font);}
.tour-launch .t-play{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(200,150,26,.16);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#e9c176;}
.tour-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:950;background:#07111e;display:none;}
.tour-modal.on{display:block;}
.tour-modal iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;display:block;}
.tour-modal .t-close{position:absolute;top:16px;inset-inline-end:16px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(7,17,30,.92);border:1px solid rgba(200,150,26,.45);color:#e9c176;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:10;}
.tour-hero{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:440px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;padding:0;background:var(--bg);}
.tour-hero img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--silk);}
.tour-hero:hover img{transform:scale(1.05);}
.tour-hero .th-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,20,38,.15) 0%,rgba(0,20,38,.15) 45%,rgba(0,20,38,.82) 100%);}
.tour-hero .th-badge{position:absolute;top:18px;inset-inline-start:18px;background:rgba(0,174,255,.92);color:#fff;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
[data-theme="dark"] .tour-hero .th-badge{background:rgba(200,150,26,.94);color:#0d0d0f;}
.tour-hero .th-play{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:.25s var(--silk);}
.tour-hero .th-play .i{width:30px;height:30px;margin-inline-start:4px;}
.tour-hero:hover .th-play{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1);background:#fff;}
.tour-hero .th-body{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:24px;inset-inline-end:24px;bottom:22px;text-align:start;}
.tour-hero .th-body b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:24px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.tour-hero .th-body span{color:#e9c176;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
[dir="rtl"] .tour-hero .th-body span{font-family:var(--font);}
@media(max-width:680px){.tour-hero{height:320px;}.tour-hero .th-body b{font-size:19px;}}

@media(max-width:1080px){
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .hero h1{font-size:28px;}
  .search-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .field.searchbtn{grid-column:1/-1;}
  .grid-comp,.grid-feat{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .grid-testi{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:none;}
  .grid-testi .tcard:first-child{grid-row:auto;}
  .grid-testi .tcard:first-child p{font-size:14.5px;}
  .perfect{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .search-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .field{border-inline-end:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .grid-comp,.grid-feat,.stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .net-banner{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:32px 26px;}
  .nb-stats{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;border-inline-start:none;padding-inline-start:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-top:24px;}
  .net-banner h3{font-size:21px;}
  .inq .frow{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .perfect .pf-left,.inq{padding:32px 26px;}
  .cta{padding:36px 28px;}
}

/* ─── Split text sup styling (Why Sierra + AI Hub headings) ─── */
.sec-head h2 sup, .ai-hub h2 sup{font-size:0.45em;font-weight:800;color:var(--pri);vertical-align:super;margin-inline-start:2px;letter-spacing:0;}
.ai-hub h2 sup{color:#34d399;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(52,211,153,.4);}

/* ─── Framer-motion + GSAP style animations ─── */
@keyframes fmCardSpin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) rotateX(-12deg) scale(.96);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) rotateX(0) scale(1);}}
@keyframes fmSlideDown{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-40px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}
@keyframes fmSlideLeft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-60px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}}
@keyframes fmSlideRight{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(60px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}}
@keyframes fmWriteOn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);filter:blur(4px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);filter:blur(0);}}
@keyframes fmScaleUp{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.85);}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}}
@keyframes fmFlip3D{from{opacity:0;transform:perspective(800px) rotateY(-15deg) translateY(20px);}to{opacity:1;transform:perspective(800px) rotateY(0) translateY(0);}}
@keyframes fmBlurIn{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(12px);transform:scale(1.05);}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:scale(1);}}
@keyframes fmClipReveal{from{opacity:0;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);}to{opacity:1;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);}}

.fm-spin{opacity:0;}.fm-spin.fm-in{animation:fmCardSpin .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-down{opacity:0;}.fm-down.fm-in{animation:fmSlideDown .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-left{opacity:0;}.fm-left.fm-in{animation:fmSlideLeft .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-right{opacity:0;}.fm-right.fm-in{animation:fmSlideRight .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-write{opacity:0;}.fm-write.fm-in{animation:fmWriteOn .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-scale{opacity:0;}.fm-scale.fm-in{animation:fmScaleUp .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-flip{opacity:0;}.fm-flip.fm-in{animation:fmFlip3D .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-blur{opacity:0;}.fm-blur.fm-in{animation:fmBlurIn .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}
.fm-clip{opacity:0;}.fm-clip.fm-in{animation:fmClipReveal .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}

.fm-d1{animation-delay:.08s}.fm-d2{animation-delay:.16s}.fm-d3{animation-delay:.24s}.fm-d4{animation-delay:.32s}.fm-d5{animation-delay:.4s}.fm-d6{animation-delay:.48s}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .fm-spin,.fm-down,.fm-left,.fm-right,.fm-write,.fm-scale,.fm-flip,.fm-blur,.fm-clip{opacity:1 !important;animation:none !important;}
}

#home-map{border:1px solid var(--line) !important;border-radius:14px !important;overflow:hidden;}
[data-theme="dark"] #home-map{border-color:#1a1a26 !important;}
/* Active state for home map beds segment buttons */
#home-map-beds button.on{background:var(--pri);color:#fff;}
[data-theme="dark"] #home-map-beds button.on{background:#e9c176;color:#0d0d0f;}
/* Smart filter dropdown animation */

.hmf-trigger:hover{border-color:var(--pri) !important;}

.cpd-marker.hot .unit-count{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--pri);}

.cpd-marker.pulse .unit-count{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--pri);}
[data-theme="dark"] .cpd-marker.pulse .unit-count{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:#c8961a;}
.cpd-marker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:32px;height:28px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(0,43,75,.92);border:2px solid #00aeff;color:#bfeaff;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;padding:0 11px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s var(--silk);white-space:nowrap;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);}
[dir="rtl"] .cpd-marker{font-family:'Cairo','Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;padding:0 12px;}

.cpd-marker.hot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00aeff,#0098e0);color:#fff;border-color:#00aeff;}
.cpd-marker.pulse{background:rgba(0,174,255,.85);color:#fff;border-color:#34d399;}

<!-- ═══ HOME PAGE MAP — Leaflet init with marker clustering ══════════════════
     Shows all compounds on an interactive map. Featured compounds pulse.
     Uses Leaflet.markercluster so nearby compounds group into styled
     clusters when zoomed out, and spread out when zoomed in.
     Clicking any marker → compounds.html?cpd=<name> -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  'use strict';
  var D = window.HZDATA;
  if (!D || !window.L) return;

  var featured = D.featured || [];
  var theme = (window.HZ && HZ.theme) ? HZ.theme() : 'light';
  var map = L.map('home-map', { scrollWheelZoom: false, zoomControl: true }).setView([30.03, 31.57], 11);
  var tiles = {
    light: 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png',
    dark: 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png'
  };
  var layer = L.tileLayer(tiles[theme], { attribution: '© OpenStreetMap © CARTO', maxZoom: 18 }).addTo(map);

  document.addEventListener('hzp:theme', function (e) {
    layer.setUrl(tiles[e.detail]);
  });

  // Marker icon: featured compounds get the 'pulse' class for the glow animation
  // Shows compound name + total unit count badge (green pill next to name)
  function markerIcon(c, isFeatured) {
    var hot = c.ai >= 9.2;
    var cls = 'cpd-marker' + (hot ? ' hot' : '') + (isFeatured ? ' pulse' : '');
    // Use Arabic name if site language is Arabic and translation exists
    var curLang = (window.HZ && HZ.lang) ? HZ.lang() : 'en';
    var displayName = (D.compoundName) ? D.compoundName(c.n, curLang) : c.n;
    // Get total unit count for this compound (from D.unitsFor generator)
    var unitCount = 0;
    if (typeof D.unitsFor === 'function') {
      try { unitCount = D.unitsFor(c.n).length; } catch (e) { unitCount = 0; }
    }
    var unitBadge = unitCount > 0 ? '<span class="unit-count">' + unitCount + '</span>' : '';
    return L.divIcon({
      className: '',
      html: '<span class="' + cls + '" title="' + displayName + ' (' + unitCount + ' units)">' + displayName + unitBadge + '</span>',
      iconSize: null
    });
  }

  // ═══ Marker Cluster Group ═══
  // When zoomed out, nearby markers group into styled clusters.
  // When zoomed in, markers spread out and are individually visible.
  var clusterGroup = L.markerClusterGroup({
    showCoverageOnHover: false,
    maxClusterRadius: 44,
    spiderfyOnMaxZoom: true,
    disableClusteringAtZoom: 11,
    iconCreateFunction: function (cluster) {
      var count = cluster.getChildCount();
      var size = count >= 10 ? 'large' : count >= 5 ? 'medium' : 'small';
      return L.divIcon({
        className: 'cpd-cluster cpd-cluster-' + size,
        html: '<span>' + count + '</span>',
        iconSize: [40, 40]
      });
    }
  });

  D.compounds.forEach(function (c) {
    var isFeatured = featured.indexOf(c.n) >= 0;
    var marker = L.marker(c.c, { icon: markerIcon(c, isFeatured), title: c.n });
    marker.on('click', function () {
      location.href = 'compounds.html?cpd=' + encodeURIComponent(c.n);
    });
    marker._compound = c; // keep a back-reference so we can filter later
    clusterGroup.addLayer(marker);
  });

  map.addLayer(clusterGroup);

  // Fit bounds to show all compounds
  try { map.fitBounds(clusterGroup.getBounds(), { padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 13 }); } catch (e) {}

  // ═══ HOME MAP FILTER (compound multi-select + single beds) ═══
  // Per user request:
  //  - Compounds: multi-select (click multiple compounds to filter)
  //  - Bedrooms: single select, exact number (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — no '+')
  var allMarkers = clusterGroup.getLayers();
  var compoundInput = document.getElementById('home-map-compound');
  var compoundDropdown = document.getElementById('hmf-compound-dropdown');
  var compoundChevron = document.getElementById('hmf-compound-chevron');
  var compoundChips = document.getElementById('hmf-compound-chips');
  var bedsWrap = document.getElementById('home-map-beds');
  var countEl = document.getElementById('home-map-count');

  // filterState.compounds = array of selected compound names (empty = all)
  // filterState.beds = exact bedroom count (0 = any)
  var filterState = { compounds: [], beds: 0 };

  // ── Build compound dropdown list ──
  function renderCompoundDropdown(query) {
    var q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    var items = D.compounds.filter(function (c) {
      if (!q) return true;
      return c.n.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
    });
    if (!items.length) {
      compoundDropdown.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;text-align:center;">No compounds found</div>';
      return;
    }
    compoundDropdown.innerHTML = items.map(function (c) {
      var isSelected = filterState.compounds.indexOf(c.n) >= 0;
      var unitCount = (typeof D.unitsFor === 'function') ? D.unitsFor(c.n).length : 0;
      return '<div class="hmf-cpd-item' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '') + '" data-cpd="' + c.n + '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;' + (isSelected ? 'background:rgba(0,174,255,.08);' : '') + '">' +
        '<span style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:5px;border:2px solid ' + (isSelected ? 'var(--pri)' : 'var(--line-2)') + ';background:' + (isSelected ? 'var(--pri)' : 'transparent') + ';display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;">' + (isSelected ? '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>' : '') + '</span>' +
        '<span style="flex:1;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);">' + c.n + '</span>' +
        '<span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;">' + unitCount + '</span>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    // Bind click on each item
    compoundDropdown.querySelectorAll('.hmf-cpd-item').forEach(function (item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var name = this.getAttribute('data-cpd');
        var idx = filterState.compounds.indexOf(name);
        if (idx >= 0) {
          filterState.compounds.splice(idx, 1); // deselect
        } else {
          filterState.compounds.push(name); // select
        }
        renderCompoundDropdown(compoundInput.value);
        renderChips();
        applyFilter();
        updateActiveBadge();
      });
      item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
        if (!this.classList.contains('selected')) this.style.background = 'var(--bg)';
      });
      item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        if (!this.classList.contains('selected')) this.style.background = 'transparent';
      });
    });
  }

  // ── Render selected compound chips ──
  function renderChips() {
    if (!filterState.compounds.length) {
      compoundChips.innerHTML = '';
      compoundChips.style.minHeight = '0';
      return;
    }
    compoundChips.style.minHeight = '32px';
    compoundChips.innerHTML = filterState.compounds.map(function (name) {
      return '<span class="hmf-chip" data-cpd="' + name + '" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--pri);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 10px 5px 12px;border-radius:999px;gap:6px;">' +
        '<span>' + name + '</span>' +
        '<button type="button" data-remove="' + name + '" style="border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;" aria-label="Remove ' + name + '">×</button>' +
      '</span>';
    }).join('');
    // Bind remove buttons
    compoundChips.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var name = this.getAttribute('data-remove');
        var idx = filterState.compounds.indexOf(name);
        if (idx >= 0) filterState.compounds.splice(idx, 1);
        renderCompoundDropdown(compoundInput.value);
        renderChips();
        applyFilter();
        updateActiveBadge();
      });
    });
  }

  function applyFilter() {
    var selectedCompounds = filterState.compounds;
    var exactBeds = filterState.beds;
    var visible = [];

    allMarkers.forEach(function (m) {
      var c = m._compound;
      if (!c) return;
      // Compound filter: if compounds selected, marker must be in the list
      var matchCompound = !selectedCompounds.length || selectedCompounds.indexOf(c.n) >= 0;
      // Beds filter: if beds > 0, compound must have at least one unit with EXACTLY that bedroom count
      var matchBeds = true;
      if (exactBeds > 0 && typeof D.unitsFor === 'function') {
        var units = D.unitsFor(c.n);
        matchBeds = units.some(function (u) { return u.beds === exactBeds; });
      }
      var visible_now = matchCompound && matchBeds;
      if (clusterGroup.hasLayer(m) && !visible_now) {
        clusterGroup.removeLayer(m);
      } else if (!clusterGroup.hasLayer(m) && visible_now) {
        clusterGroup.addLayer(m);
      }
      if (visible_now) visible.push(m);
    });

    countEl.textContent = visible.length + ' ' + ((window.HZ && HZ.lang && HZ.lang() === 'ar') ? 'كمبوند' : (visible.length === 1 ? 'compound' : 'compounds'));

    // Refit bounds to visible markers
    if (visible.length > 0) {
      try {
        var group = L.featureGroup(visible);
        map.fitBounds(group.getBounds(), { padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 13 });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); }, 100);
  }

  // ── Compound input: search + open dropdown ──
  if (compoundInput) {
    compoundInput.addEventListener('focus', function () {
      compoundDropdown.style.display = 'block';
      compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
      renderCompoundDropdown(compoundInput.value);
    });
    compoundInput.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      compoundDropdown.style.display = 'block';
      compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
      renderCompoundDropdown(e.target.value);
    });
    // Prevent document click handler from closing dropdown when clicking input
    compoundInput.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
  }
  // Close dropdown when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('#hmf-compound-dropdown') && !e.target.closest('#home-map-compound') && !e.target.closest('#hmf-compound-chevron')) {
      compoundDropdown.style.display = 'none';
      compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(0)';
    }
  });
  // Chevron click toggles dropdown
  if (compoundChevron) {
    compoundChevron.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var isOpen = compoundDropdown.style.display === 'block';
      if (isOpen) {
        compoundDropdown.style.display = 'none';
        compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(0)';
      } else {
        compoundDropdown.style.display = 'block';
        compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        renderCompoundDropdown(compoundInput.value);
        compoundInput.focus();
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Beds selector (single select, exact match) ──
  if (bedsWrap) {
    bedsWrap.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        bedsWrap.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('on'); });
        b.classList.add('on');
        filterState.beds = +b.dataset.b;
        applyFilter();
        updateActiveBadge();
      });
    });
  }

  // ── Smart dropdown toggle ──
  var hmfTrigger = document.getElementById('hmf-trigger');
  var hmfPanel = document.getElementById('hmf-panel');
  var hmfReset = document.getElementById('hmf-reset');
  var activeBadge = document.getElementById('hmf-active-badge');

  function updateActiveBadge() {
    var count = 0;
    if (filterState.compounds.length) count++;
    if (filterState.beds > 0) count++;
    if (count > 0) {
      activeBadge.style.display = 'inline-flex';
      activeBadge.textContent = count;
    } else {
      activeBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  if (hmfTrigger && hmfPanel) {
    hmfTrigger.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var isOpen = hmfPanel.style.display !== 'none';
      if (isOpen) {
        hmfPanel.style.display = 'none';
        hmfTrigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      } else {
        hmfPanel.style.display = 'block';
        hmfTrigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    });
  }
  if (hmfReset) {
    hmfReset.addEventListener('click', function () {
      compoundInput.value = '';
      filterState.compounds = [];
      filterState.beds = 0;
      compoundDropdown.style.display = 'none';
      compoundChevron.style.transform = 'rotate(0)';
      renderChips();
      bedsWrap.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (x, i) { x.classList.toggle('on', i === 0); });
      applyFilter();
      updateActiveBadge();
    });
  }

  // Initial count
  countEl.textContent = allMarkers.length + ' ' + ((window.HZ && HZ.lang && HZ.lang() === 'ar') ? 'كمبوند' : 'compounds');

  // Fix tile rendering after layout settles
  setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); }, 200);
  setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); }, 800);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { map.invalidateSize(); });

  // ─── Re-render markers when language changes ───
  // When user switches EN↔AR, compound names on markers need to update.
  // We listen for the custom 'hzp:lang' event dispatched by shared.js.
  document.addEventListener('hzp:lang', function (e) {
    var newLang = e.detail;
    // Refresh each marker's icon with the new language name
    allMarkers.forEach(function (m) {
      var c = m._compound;
      if (!c) return;
      var isFeat = featured.indexOf(c.n) >= 0;
      m.setIcon(markerIcon(c, isFeat));
    });
    // Update count text
    var visibleCount = clusterGroup.getLayers().length;
    countEl.textContent = visibleCount + ' ' + (newLang === 'ar' ? 'كمبوند' : (visibleCount === 1 ? 'compound' : 'compounds'));
    // Update datalist options with Arabic names
    if (compoundList) {
      compoundList.innerHTML = D.compounds.map(function (c) {
        var name = D.compoundName ? D.compoundName(c.n, newLang) : c.n;
        return '<option value="' + name + '">';
      }).join('');
    }
    // Update filter input placeholder (data-i18n-ph handles this, but reload-safe)
  });

  // ─── Sticky map: freeze when scrolled past, unfreeze when leaving section ───
  var mapWrap = document.getElementById('map-sticky-wrap');
  var mapSection = document.getElementById('map-section');
  if (mapWrap && mapSection) {
    var stickyActive = false;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      var secRect = mapSection.getBoundingClientRect();
      var wrapRect = mapWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      // Activate sticky when the map wrapper top goes above the header
      if (wrapRect.top < 64 && secRect.bottom > 300 && !stickyActive) {
        mapWrap.classList.add('sticky');
        stickyActive = true;
        setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); }, 300);
      } else if ((wrapRect.top >= 64 || secRect.bottom <= 300) && stickyActive) {
        mapWrap.classList.remove('sticky');
        stickyActive = false;
        setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); }, 300);
      }
    }, { passive: true });
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ═══ PERCIPIO-STYLE SCROLL MOTION — JS ════════════════════════════════════
     Clean scroll-triggered fade-ups. No preloader, no cursor, no magnetic.
     Just elegant content reveals as you scroll. Works on all devices. -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  'use strict';
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // ─── Apply .se-fade + framer-motion classes to key content blocks ───────
  function setupFades() {
    // Basic fade-up for general elements
    var fadeSelectors = [
      '.sec-head .eyebrow', '.hz-sec-head h2',
      '.hz-block h2', '.hz-cta h3',
      '.search-card', '.hz-search-card',
      '.hz-comp', '.hz-room', '.hz-stats .stat', '.hz-cta',
      '.block .wrap > p', '.cpd-card',
      '.testi-card', '.ai-tile',
      '#tour .wrap > div'
    ];
    document.querySelectorAll(fadeSelectors.join(',')).forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.dataset.seFade) return;
      el.classList.add('se-fade');
      el.dataset.seFade = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: headings slide down from top
    document.querySelectorAll('.sec-head h2, .ai-hub h2').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add('fm-down');
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: listing cards spin-in with stagger
    document.querySelectorAll('.grid-props .pcard, #prop-grid .pcard').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add('fm-spin', 'fm-d' + ((i % 6) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: Why Sierra features slide from left/right alternating
    document.querySelectorAll('.grid-feat .feat').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add(i % 2 === 0 ? 'fm-left' : 'fm-right', 'fm-d' + ((i % 4) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: net-banner slides from left
    var nb = document.querySelector('.net-banner');
    if (nb && !nb.dataset.fmDone) { nb.classList.add('fm-left'); nb.dataset.fmDone = '1'; }

    // Framer-motion: AI cards spin-in
    document.querySelectorAll('.ai-card').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add('fm-spin', 'fm-d' + ((i % 4) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: compound cards slide from left/right
    document.querySelectorAll('.grid-comp .comp, #comp-grid .comp').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add(i % 2 === 0 ? 'fm-left' : 'fm-right', 'fm-d' + ((i % 4) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: stats write-on effect
    document.querySelectorAll('.stats .stat').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add('fm-write', 'fm-d' + ((i % 4) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: 3D tour section blur-in
    var tourSec = document.getElementById('tour');
    if (tourSec && !tourSec.dataset.fmDone) { tourSec.classList.add('fm-blur'); tourSec.dataset.fmDone = '1'; }

    // Framer-motion: map section clip-reveal
    var mapSec = document.getElementById('map-section');
    if (mapSec && !mapSec.dataset.fmDone) { mapSec.classList.add('fm-clip'); mapSec.dataset.fmDone = '1'; }

    // Framer-motion: insights cards flip-3D
    document.querySelectorAll('#insights-grid > a').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.classList.add('fm-flip', 'fm-d' + ((i % 3) + 1));
      el.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });

    // Framer-motion: CTA scale-up
    var cta = document.querySelector('.cta');
    if (cta && !cta.dataset.fmDone) { cta.classList.add('fm-scale'); cta.dataset.fmDone = '1'; }

    // Framer-motion: AI preview images blur-in
    document.querySelectorAll('.ai-hub a img').forEach(function (el, i) {
      if (el.parentElement.dataset.fmDone) return;
      el.parentElement.classList.add('fm-blur', 'fm-d' + ((i % 3) + 1));
      el.parentElement.dataset.fmDone = '1';
    });
  }

  // ─── Check which elements are in viewport + reveal them ─────────────────
  function checkFades() {
    // Trigger se-fade (Percipio-style fade-up)
    document.querySelectorAll('.se-fade:not(.se-fade-in)').forEach(function (el) {
      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.top < window.innerHeight * 0.88 && r.bottom > 0) {
        el.classList.add('se-fade-in');
      }
    });
    // Trigger framer-motion animations (must include EVERY fm-* class that
    // starts at opacity:0 — fm-blur, fm-clip, fm-flip, fm-scale were previously
    // missing, which kept the 3D tour, map, insights cards, CTA and AI preview
    // images permanently invisible. See lines ~1295-1320 for class assignment.)
    document.querySelectorAll('.fm-spin:not(.fm-in), .fm-down:not(.fm-in), .fm-left:not(.fm-in), .fm-right:not(.fm-in), .fm-write:not(.fm-in), .fm-scale:not(.fm-in), .fm-flip:not(.fm-in), .fm-blur:not(.fm-in), .fm-clip:not(.fm-in)').forEach(function (el) {
      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.top < window.innerHeight * 0.88 && r.bottom > 0) {
        el.classList.add('fm-in');
      }
    });
  }

  // ─── Stagger: add delay to grid children for cascade effect ────────────
  function setupStagger() {
    var grids = document.querySelectorAll('.grid-comp, .hz-grid-comp, .hz-rooms, .grid-props, .hz-grid-props, .stats .grid, .hz-stats .grid');
    grids.forEach(function (grid) {
      var children = grid.children;
      for (var i = 0; i < children.length && i < 8; i++) {
        children[i].style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.08) + 's';
      }
    });
  }

  // ─── Smooth scroll: REMOVED ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The custom smooth scroll (both the wheel-hijack version and the lerp
  // version) was causing issues:
  //   - wheel preventDefault blocked native scroll on some setups
  //   - window.scrollTo override broke nav link clicks + scrollIntoView
  // Native browser scrolling is now used — it works perfectly on Windows
  // (mouse wheel, trackpad) and Mac (trackpad momentum scroll) without
  // any JavaScript intervention. The scroll-triggered fade-up reveals
  // still work because they listen to the native 'scroll' event.

  // ─── Init ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (reduced) {
    // Show everything immediately
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.se-fade').forEach(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('se-fade-in');
      });
    });
  } else {
    // Setup after portal JS renders content
    setTimeout(function () {
      setupFades();
      setupStagger();
      checkFades();
      window.addEventListener('scroll', checkFades, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', checkFades, { passive: true });
    }, 500);

    // Re-check after dynamic content loads (portal JS renders async)
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
      setupFades();
      checkFades();
    });
    obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 5000);

    // This prevents the entire 3D tour / map / CTA / insights sections from
    // staying invisible forever if the scroll check somehow misses them

        '.fm-spin:not(.fm-in), .fm-down:not(.fm-in), .fm-left:not(.fm-in), ' +
        '.fm-right:not(.fm-in), .fm-write:not(.fm-in), .fm-scale:not(.fm-in), ' +
        '.fm-flip:not(.fm-in), .fm-blur:not(.fm-in), .fm-clip:not(.fm-in)'
      ).forEach(function (el) {
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.top < window.innerHeight && r.bottom > 0) {
          el.classList.add('fm-in');
        }
      });
    }, 4000);
    // Ultimate backstop: after 8s, force-reveal EVERYTHING still hidden so
    // no section is permanently invisible regardless of viewport state.

        '[class*="fm-"]:not(.fm-in), .se-fade:not(.se-fade-in)'

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--r-card', r + 'px');

<script>
(function(){
  var hub=document.getElementById('ai');
  if(!hub) return;
  var mark=document.getElementById('ai-watermark');
  var cards=[];
  function collect(){cards=[].slice.call(hub.querySelectorAll('.ai-card'));}
  collect();
  new MutationObserver(collect).observe(document.getElementById('ai-grid')||hub,{childList:true});
  var raf=null,mx=0,my=0;
  hub.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
    var r=hub.getBoundingClientRect();
    var px=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-0.5, py=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-0.5;
    mx=px;my=py;
    if(raf) return;
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      raf=null;
      if(mark) mark.style.transform='translate3d('+(mx*-34)+'px,'+(my*-34)+'px,0) rotate('+(mx*3)+'deg)';
      var cr;
      cards.forEach(function(c){
        cr=c.getBoundingClientRect();
        var cx=(e.clientX-cr.left)/cr.width, cy=(e.clientY-cr.top)/cr.height;
        if(cx<-0.15||cx>1.15||cy<-0.15||cy>1.15){c.style.transform='';return;}
        c.style.setProperty('--mx',(cx*100)+'%');
        c.style.setProperty('--my',(cy*100)+'%');
        c.style.transform='perspective(720px) rotateX('+((0.5-cy)*5)+'deg) rotateY('+((cx-0.5)*5)+'deg) translateY(-4px)';
      });
    });
  });
  hub.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){
    if(mark) mark.style.transform='';
    cards.forEach(function(c){c.style.transform='';});
  });
})();
